snippet.title: Drums Rock - Simple Plan DLC
snippet.description:
A new DLC has arrived in Drums Rock and is now available. Get this DLC with a large number of new songs!

Get this DLC and play songs from Simple Plan

Add-Ons DLC:
"Welcome to my Life" - Simple Plan
"Shut up!" - Simple Plan
"Crazy" - Simple Plan
"Time to Say Goodbye" - Simple Plan
